newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS - Hoyts to make A$61.1 mln placement.
newsitem.headline: RTRS - Hoyts to make A$61.1 mln placement.

text.p: Hoyts Cinemas Ltd said on Thursday it intended to make a placement of 22.2 million shares at A$2.75 a share to institutions to raise a total of A$61.1 million.

Hoyts said the funds raised from the placement would be used to fund the purchase of a 35 percent stake in Mexican cinema developer Cinemex and to provide additional finacial flexibility for the company's international growth plans.
Hoyts said it had signed an agreement with Cinemex whereby Hoyts would inject A$28 million into Cinemex over the next year.

"Our entry and expansion into Latin America conforms with our objectives to expand our operations into new cinema markets which are currently underscreened or poorly serviced, and where Hoyts can be the leading operator with a long term competitive advantage," Hoyts' chief executive Peter Ivany said.

Hoyts said Cinemex operates seven new cinema complexes with 65 screens in Mexico City and is scheduled to open another seven sites with 92 screens in and around Mexico City during 1997, of which 18 screens were currently under construction.

"Cinemex's current market share of the (Mexico City) market is 20 percent. Cinemex plans to develop and operate 350 screens by 2000 targeting around 50 percent of Mexico City's box office admissions," Hoyts said. The placement will be fully underwritten by SBC Warburg Australia Ltd, Hoyts said.
